# Nishant Chaudhary, Senior Frontend Engineer and LLM Evaluation Specialist

> Senior Frontend Engineer at Samsung Electronics (2024 to now), based in New Delhi. About five years of production React and TypeScript: enterprise web apps, design systems, micro-frontends, and the AI developer tooling around them. Also works in AI model evaluation for Handshake, micro1, Snorkel AI and Turing: benchmark task authoring, rubric and grader design, verifier hardening and model failure analysis. Open to remote roles with EU teams; works 12:00 to 21:00 IST to cover CET core hours.

## Experience

- Samsung Electronics, Senior Frontend Engineer (Jul 2024 to now): plugin-based micro-frontend platform on Vite Module Federation (new app onboarding from hours to under a minute, six product squads); Vite and Turborepo migration with a shared design system (close to 60% component reuse); 20+ custom MCP servers handling 60 to 70% of routine frontend work; leads a team of five on the TVPlus Test Suite.
- Safex Chemicals, Web Developer (Mar 2023 to Jun 2024): B2B ordering platform for 25,000+ customers (repeat orders up 22%, support tickets down about 30%); load time from 4.2s to 2.5s; SAP-connected portal for 500+ staff.
- DevsLane, Frontend Engineer (Nov 2021 to Mar 2023): eight client products from Figma; Storybook library of 40+ accessible components; WCAG 2.1 AA.
- AI model evaluation and benchmark authoring for Handshake, micro1, Snorkel AI and Turing (2026 to now): adversarial benchmark tasks for frontier coding agents, rubrics and verifiers tested against reward hacking, pass@k and trajectory analysis, expert review of SWE tasks built from real pull requests, rubric-graded document tasks, and engineering problem statements with checkable success criteria.
